subject: reasoning
question:
Observe the dots on a dice (one to six dots) in the following figures. How many dots are contained on the face opposite to that containing four dots?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd114815131e9463641dfba40a21489b4531a598fb998b250fa79d5151ae070f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3253bed0f7c84140e51e82c647a5e2473b119b8af785a7ea47b87c1bf9f56918.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As one dot is common on both the dices, it is clear that two dots, three dots, four dots, and five dots are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. six dots will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebeda721956ebcc6d507696db2d0904e67674baada80aa5de8744b89e5a4bfcb.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cbece508c06af62bf9d81e7375ea8ce61d49c1a57fcb2d176df14d0fec03f56.png] 

Opposite pairs:

Three dots → Five dots

Two dots → Four dots

One dot → Six dots

So, the opposite side of "Four dots" will be side "Two dots".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
